sub: Connect HubSpot to Claude once. Then paste this before every call and walk in ready.
intro: Here's the call prep prompt I use. You set it up once, then it's one paste before every call.

steps.title: Connect HubSpot to Claude
steps.text: In Claude, go to Settings > Connectors and connect HubSpot. You only do this once.

steps.title: Paste this before any call
steps.text: Fill in the contact's name and company, then paste it into a new chat.
steps.prompt: Prep me for my call with [contact name] at [company]. Look them up in HubSpot. Give me: the deal stage and amount, a short recap of our last 3 emails or notes, any open tasks, and what they care about most. Then give me 3 questions to ask and the one next step I should book before we hang up. Keep it to one screen.

steps.title: Walk in ready
steps.text: Run it before every call. Use the 3 questions, and book the next step before you hang up.
